Description: ATP/glucose ratio should be realistic (P/O ratio constraint)
No ATP production without carbon source (glucose required)
No glutamate synthesis without nitrogen source (NH4 required)
No alanine synthesis without nitrogen source
No cysteine synthesis without sulfur source (SO4 required)
No methionine synthesis without sulfur source
No heme production without iron (Fe2+ required)
No nucleotide synthesis without nitrogen (purine ring requires N)
No DNA precursors without nitrogen source
No cytochrome oxidase without oxygen (aerobic respiration)
No glycerol-3P without carbon source (lipid backbone requires glucose)
No ribose-5P without carbon source (PPP requires glucose)
No PRPP without carbon source (nucleotide precursor requires glucose)
